observations.name: coverage_notes
observations.value: Root package only (github.com/rs/zerolog). Subpackages log, hlog, diode, journald, pkgerrors, internal, cmd are referenced in the guides but have no API reference pages in this build; that is a documented coverage gap in the report. Guide content is condensed from the project's README.md at the pinned commit (30,094 bytes), keeping code examples verbatim. No test-file examples were rendered (the snapshot recorded 0 package examples). Source files were fetched as plain data over HTTPS at the pinned commit (no repository clone); the godoc snapshot parses them with go/parser and does not execute target code.

observations.value: Not yet published (HTTP 404 at check time). The receipt itself is sealed and valid: runx verify reports valid=true, digest valid, signature valid. The receipt file is publicly fetchable at receipt_file_url for independent verification.

summary: Sourcey documentation site for the rs/zerolog Go package (github.com/rs/zerolog), generated from the pinned source commit 284f7c889533b78603191349f4a5c48628d7afd2 (10 Nov 2026, MIT). Built with Sourcey 3.9.5 using the godoc adapter in snapshot mode: a godoc.json snapshot of the root package (311 public API symbols) plus an overview, a quickstart, and five guides condensed from the project's own README at the pinned commit. The static site (10 pages) is published at https://zerolog-docs.readthedocs.io/ and every page returns HTTP 200.
